outlets.name: BRUZZ
outlets.credible: Brussels' Dutch-language regional news and culture media (city-funded editorial); credible native coverage of neighbourhoods and restaurants (e.g. its Sint-Joost / 'Brussel bij de Turk' features and dedicated restaurant reviews).

outlets.name: Commune de Saint-Josse-ten-Noode
outlets.credible: Official Saint-Josse-ten-Noode commune portal; authoritative civic/restauration listings for the commune (Turkish Chaussée de Haecht strip).

outlets.name: ELLE Belgique
outlets.credible: Belgian edition of ELLE; credible curated food/lifestyle editorial (e.g. its best-croissants-of-Brussels feature).

outlets.name: Inside Brussels
outlets.credible: Brussels English-language lifestyle and city-guide outlet with editorial 'best of' features; credible as corroboration (bakeries, restaurants).

outlets.name: Brussels' Kitchen
outlets.credible: Long-running independent Brussels dining editorial (curated reviews, not user ratings); credible native recommender for restaurants and bars.

outlets.name: European Coffee Trip
outlets.credible: Established European specialty-coffee editorial guide; credible authority for specialty roasters and coffee bars (MOK, Brussels scene).

outlets.name: L'Éventail
outlets.credible: Belgian art-de-vivre magazine; credible curated 'bonnes adresses' editorial (natural-wine bars, restaurants).

outlets.name: VRT NWS
outlets.credible: Belgian Flemish public broadcaster; credible native editorial (e.g. its 'best café' designation of La Fleur en Papier Doré).

outlets.name: gardens.brussels (Brussels-Capital green spaces)
outlets.credible: Official Brussels-Capital green-spaces portal; authoritative for the region's gardens and parks (Abbaye de la Cambre gardens).
